name: conflict_v1
description: Fictional case whose pages disagree on two facts. A reliable system must surface BOTH pages so the conflict is visible instead of silently picking one.
pages: 1. The complainant states that the agreement of lease was signed on 3 March 2018 in the presence of two witnesses. 2. The monthly rent agreed was Rs. 12,000.
3. The respondent states in his reply that the agreement of lease was signed on 5 April 2018 and not in March. 4. According to the respondent the monthly rent agreed was Rs. 9,000.
5. The Court notes that the originals of the lease were not produced by either party.

questions.question: On what date was the agreement of lease signed?
What was the monthly rent agreed in the lease?
